headlines.text: Turning the clock back to 2022: the AEW Interim World Title was up for grabs as Jon Moxley vs. Chris Jericho went to war, appearing on Dynamite, rated 8.43 ? a fantastic contest. Moxley made Jericho tap to a Rear Naked Choke in a bloody main event, and the show closed with a returning CM Punk facing him down for the first time as interim champion.
Back on this day in 2024, The Varsity Athletes left that name behind for good, stepping out as The Premier Athletes after 2 matches under the old identity, on Collision.
Turning the clock back to 2024: Gunns & Robinson vs. House of Black met in a Number One Contender, headlining the show on Collision, rated 6.61.

secondaries.text: Looking back to 2022, when Andrade & Rush arrived in AEW as a team, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.32 ? a well-worked match.
It was 2024 when Thunder Rosa vs. Deonna Purrazzo fought it out in a Texas Bullrope match on Collision, rated 7.04 ? a good, competitive contest with the women's division on full display.

Turning the clock back to 2022: Darby Allin vs. Brody King settled things in a Coffin Match, setting the tone as the night's opener on Dynamite, rated 7.56 ? a good, competitive contest in a hard-fought men's division clash ? part of that year's Quake by the Lake '22.
